Application Data.NAME: CleanSweep Solutions, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: CleanSweep Solutions, LLC specializes in providing comprehensive janitorial and cleaning services for commercial and residential properties. Our operations include routine cleaning, carpet and floor maintenance, window washing, and post-construction cleanup. We utilize environmentally friendly cleaning products and equipment to ensure a safe and healthy environment for our clients. Our trained staff follows strict quality control measures and safety protocols to deliver exceptional service tailored to the specific needs of each client. We also offer customizable cleaning schedules to accommodate varying client requirements.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a slip-and-fall incident occurred at a client's location due to a wet floor that was not marked properly, resulting in minor injuries. The client filed a claim with a total incurred cost of $2,500. The claim has been closed, and the business covered the cost through its liability insurance.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B rated safe, UL listed, fire resistant, 2-hour rating, capacity 500 lbs
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guards and perimeter fencing in place during off-hours.
